updates.title: CVE-2026-50481: Azure Active Directory Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: A vulnerability in Azure Active Directory allows authorized attackers to modify assumed-immutable data and escalate privileges. Admins should apply security updates immediately to prevent unauthorized privilege elevation within their Entra ID environments.

updates.title: CVE-2026-59115: Microsoft Entra Provisioning Service Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: A path traversal vulnerability in Microsoft Entra Provisioning Service (SyncFabric) permits authorized attackers to escalate privileges on the network. Organizations should prioritize patching to protect identity synchronization pipelines from privilege abuse.

updates.title: CVE-2026-62869: Azure Entra ID Spoofing Vulnerability
updates.summary: Insufficient verification of data authenticity in Azure Entra ID allows authorized attackers to perform spoofing attacks over the network. Admins must install security updates to prevent identity spoofing and unauthorized impersonation.

updates.title: CVE-2026-65668: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: Improper access control in Microsoft Purview eDiscovery allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges across the network. Compliance officers and admins managing eDiscovery workflows should apply available security patches to restrict unauthorized access to sensitive investigation data.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – DLP for Copilot Web Search Protection
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP is expanding to prevent sensitive data in prompts from being used in external web searches by Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat. This real-time control helps organizations block unintended data exposure to external search engines and third-party AI services.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Support for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: DLP and auto-labeling capabilities now extend to third-party platforms including Google Workspace, Box, Dropbox, Salesforce, ServiceNow, AWS, and Cisco Webex. This unifies data protection across hybrid cloud environments, reducing compliance blind spots for organizations using multi-cloud strategies.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP – Device Health Reporting Dashboard
updates.summary: A new dashboard allows admins to monitor device health across all endpoints and verify readiness to receive policy updates. Security teams can now quickly identify devices at risk of policy compliance failures and take remedial action.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Adaptive Scope Evaluation with Lifecycle Status Control
updates.summary: Administrators gain explicit control over how recipient and site owner lifecycle states are evaluated in Adaptive Scopes, ensuring policy targeting stays aligned with organizational personnel changes. This reduces over-scoping and improves governance precision for retention and DLP policies.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Archive SharePoint Files Under Retention
updates.summary: Administrators can now add file archiving actions to SharePoint retention policies, moving inactive content to low-cost storage while maintaining compliance and discoverability. This extends DLM beyond keep/delete to optimize storage costs without sacrificing governance.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Guided Diagnostics for DLP Troubleshooting
updates.summary: A new guided experience helps admins diagnose why DLP policies behave unexpectedly, showing which policies triggered, evaluation order, and condition-by-condition results. E5 customers gain Copilot-assisted insights to accelerate troubleshooting and policy optimization.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection – Auto-Labeling Scale Increase
updates.summary: Maximum auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive increases from 100,000 to 500,000 files per tenant per day, enabling organizations to label and protect larger data estates faster. This closes labeling gaps before Copilot deployments and strengthens data readiness.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft 365 Copilot – Government Cloud Support
updates.summary: DLP protections for Copilot prompts now roll out to government cloud environments, preventing sensitive data in prompts from influencing responses or grounding Microsoft 365 or web searches. Government agencies can now enforce consistent data protection policies across Copilot interactions.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – SLA-Based Alert Reporting Dashboard
updates.summary: A new out-of-box dashboard tracks MTTA, MTTD, and MTTR metrics against configurable SLAs for DLP alerts, showing trends and top sensitive information types. Admins can now measure and optimize their incident response performance against defined service levels.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Rule-Based Alert Auto-Resolution and Tagging
updates.summary: Administrators can define rules that automatically resolve predictable DLP alerts and apply tags for routing based on business context. This reduces alert fatigue, letting security teams focus on genuine threats while automating routine alert disposition.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Network Data Security with Global Secure Access Integration
updates.summary: DLP integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to intercept and inspect text and AI interactions at the network layer, blocking sensitive data from reaching untrusted cloud apps and generative AI platforms. This closes gaps in browser, API, and add-in-based data exfiltration.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management – Unified Alert Experience
updates.summary: The Triage Agent and Standard alert dashboards merge into a single alerts list, allowing analysts to view, preview, and manage both classic and agent-triaged alerts with expanded user profile signals from Entra ID. This unified view streamlines insider risk investigation workflows.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management – Expanded Note Capabilities
updates.summary: Analysts and investigators can now add and view notes on both alerts and cases with automatic system-generated notes for status changes, assignments, and escalations. This improves audit trail visibility and collaboration on insider risk cases.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection – Auto-Labeling Per-Policy Coverage Report
updates.summary: A new per-policy coverage report shows file volumes labeled or pending labeling, and compares enforcement progress against the latest simulation snapshot. This helps admins identify enforcement gaps and files missed during simulation.
